concerns.text: The plan filters for repositories with ≥ 1 000 ⭐ and ≥ 100 PRs, but the three cited PR parquet datasets (nebius/SWE-rebench‑V2‑PRs, loubnabnl/prs‑v2‑sample, davanstrien/authors_merged_model_prs) do not appear to include a `repo_stars` field. Without star counts the filter cannot be applied directly on the dataset, requiring additional API calls that are not accounted for in the pipeline.

Feature extraction (FR‑003) requires a `ci_build_time` attribute for each PR. The cited datasets are described only as containing PR metadata and diffs; there is no explicit evidence they provide CI build duration. If this field is missing, the required covariate for propensity‑score matching will be unavailable.

The compute feasibility section assumes CPU‑only CodeLlama‑7B‑4bit‑GGUF can generate snippets ≤ 30 s each, but the total number of synthetic snippets is not bounded. Depending on the size of the filtered PR set, the generation step could easily exceed the 6 h wall‑time limit on a 2 vCPU runner. An explicit estimate of maximum snippet count or a sampling cap is needed to guarantee feasibility.
